name: living-room-fit
description: Plan seating, tables and viewing geometry.

interface.longDescription: Plan seating, tables and viewing geometry. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Inspect living-room placements; Check a sofa and coffee table gap; Calculate a screen viewing angle. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me check a sofa and coffee table gap.

prompts: Help me check a sofa and coffee table gap.
Help me calculate a screen viewing angle.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Lounge Fit: Living Rooms workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me inspect living-room placements with these supplied values: {"width_cm":400,"depth_cm":500,"furniture":[{"name":"Sofa","width_cm":180,"depth_cm":85,"x_cm":20,"y_cm":20},{"name":"Table","width_cm":90,"depth_cm":50,"x_cm":220,"y_cm":180}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses living_room_fit_seating_layout with the supplied inputs. Returns {"width_cm":400,"depth_cm":500,"room_area_m2":20,"items":[{"name":"Sofa","width_cm":180,"depth_cm":85,"x_cm":20,"y_cm":20,"inside":true},{"name":"Table","width_cm":90,"depth_cm":50,"x_cm":220,"y_cm":180,"inside":true}],"collisions":[],"occupied_area_m2":1.98}. Shows the actual room result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check a sofa and coffee table gap. Reproducible inputs: {"sofa_front_y_cm":100,"table_back_y_cm":145,"chosen_min_cm":40,"chosen_max_cm":50}

positive.expected_behavior: Uses living_room_fit_table_gap with the supplied inputs. Returns {"gap_cm":45,"within_chosen_range":true,"overlap":false}. Shows the actual measurement result. Does not fabricate external data.
